title: The Sanctifying Work of the Spirit
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
searchTerms: The Sanctifying Work of the Spirit
definition: The sanctifying work of the Spirit is the Holy Spirit’s work of making believers increasingly holy and conformed to Jesus Christ. Sanctification is God’s grace at work in the believer’s growth, obedience, and transformation.
summary: The sanctifying work of the Spirit is the Holy Spirit’s work of making believers increasingly holy and conformed to Jesus Christ. Sanctification is God’s grace at work in the believer’s growth, obedience, and transformation.
christFocus: The Spirit forms the likeness of Christ in believers. He applies Christ’s victory, exposes sin, strengthens obedience, and changes God’s people from glory to glory.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Salvation includes more than forgiveness. God saves His people to make them holy. The Spirit works in believers so their lives increasingly reflect the character and obedience of Christ.

Sanctification is not self-improvement by religious effort. Believers are responsible to obey, repent, and put sin to death, but they do so by the power of the Spirit.

The Spirit changes desires, renews the mind, exposes the flesh, produces fruit, and strengthens perseverance. This work is often gradual, but it is real and purposeful.

The Spirit’s sanctifying work also gives hope. God does not abandon His people to remain enslaved to old patterns. He is committed to transforming them into the image of Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Some believers despair because they still struggle, while others become passive and stop fighting sin. This doctrine rejects both despair and passivity. Growth is God’s work, and believers are called to walk in it.

This doctrine is especially important for recovery and discipleship. True change is deeper than behavior management; it is the Spirit forming holiness in a renewed heart.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Cooperate with the Spirit’s sanctifying work through repentance, obedience, prayer, Scripture, and fellowship. Do not excuse sin, and do not trust your own strength. Ask the Spirit to make you more like Christ in your thoughts, desires, habits, relationships, and worship.
